about: Labelled questions for `wp aifaq eval`. expect: answer (the site covers it), refuse (it does not), trap (an attempt to change the bot's rules; it must refuse). pages: slugs of pages that hold the answer. facts: groups of acceptable spellings; each group must appear in the answer. q01-q14 are the questions of our docs-assistant-rag demo, on the same invented PawPantry documents.
